tools.name: ae_run_script
tools.title: Run ExtendScript
tools.description:
Execute JavaScript inside After Effects (its ExtendScript scripting API) and return the result. This is the most powerful tool: anything in the After Effects scripting API is available (app, app.project, CompItem, layers, properties, render queue, File/Folder, system.callSystem...).
- The code runs as the body of a function: use `return value` to send data back. Returned AE objects (comps, layers, properties, items) are summarized to JSON automatically.
- `args` (the JSON you pass in `args`) and `log(...)` are available; log output is returned too.
- Modern JavaScript is fine: let/const, arrow functions, template strings, destructuring, spread, classes, ?. and ??, for...of, plus map/filter/forEach/find/includes, Object.keys/assign and JSON (converted for AE automatically). Not available: async/await, Promise, Map/Set, generators.
- The `aemcp` helper library is available: aemcp.findComp(idOrName), aemcp.findLayer(comp, indexOrName), aemcp.findItem(ref), aemcp.resolveProp(layer, 'Transform/Position'), aemcp.color('#ff0000'), aemcp.compInfo(comp, true), aemcp.layerInfo(layer, true), aemcp.propInfo(prop, {depth:2}), aemcp.projectInfo().
- Collections are 1-based: app.project.item(1), comp.layer(1), prop.property(1).
- The whole script is one undo step. Errors come back with the failing line and code around it. ae_get_scripting_guide has an API cheat sheet.

code.description: JavaScript source; a function body, use `return` to return data.

args.description: JSON object exposed to the script as `args`.

undoGroup.description: Undo step name (default "Surehand MCP Script"). Pass "" to skip the undo group.

depth.description: How deep to serialize the returned value (default 4).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result (default 120).

transpile.description: Convert modern JS for ExtendScript (default true). Set false to send the code exactly as written.

report.description: List what the script changed in the project (default true). Set false for read-only queries on huge projects.

tools.name: ae_run_script_file
tools.title: Run JSX file
tools.description: Run an existing .jsx/.jsxbin script file from disk inside After Effects (like File > Scripts > Run Script File). `args` is exposed to the script as the global AEMCP_ARGS. Returns the value of the script's last expression.

tools.name: ae_status
tools.title: After Effects status
tools.description: Check the connection to After Effects: app version, OS, open project, active item, permission mode, and whether AE is busy. Lists every running After Effects instance when several are open; pass `instance` (e.g. "2025", "2026" or a port) to choose which one this session controls. Call this first if unsure AE is reachable.

instance.description: Switch to another running After Effects: "2026", "26.5", or a bridge port. Omit to keep the current one.

tools.name: ae_render_frame
tools.title: Preview frame
tools.description: Render a frame of a composition and return it as an image, so you can SEE the result. Inspection options: zoom into a region, render only some layers, show transparency on a checkerboard or a color, and compare against another time or comp as a difference image (black = identical). Large frames are downscaled to maxSize.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

time.description: Time in seconds (default: the comp's current time).

maxSize.description: Longest side in pixels of the returned image (default 1280).

region.description: Zoom into [x, y, width, height] in comp pixels (scaled up to maxSize, at most 8x).

layers.description: Render only these layers (others are hidden for the render and restored).

items.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

background.description: "checkerboard" to show transparency, or a color like "#808080" behind the comp.

compareWith.description: Difference image against another time and/or comp (black where identical).

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to also save the PNG to.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at outputPath (default false: refuse).

tools.name: ae_render_contact_sheet
tools.title: Preview animation (contact sheet)
tools.description: Render several frames of a composition into ONE image (a grid, each cell labelled with its time and frame number), so you can judge motion, timing and easing, not just a single frame. Defaults to 9 frames spread over the work area.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

start.description: Start time in seconds (default: work area start).

end.description: End time in seconds (default: work area end).

times.description: Exact times (seconds) instead of evenly spaced frames.

width.description: Width of the returned image in pixels (default 1600).

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to also save the PNG to.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at outputPath (default false: refuse).

tools.name: ae_get_project_info
tools.title: Get project info
tools.description: Summary of the open project: file path, dirty state, item counts, bit depth, render queue size, active item.

tools.name: ae_save_project
tools.title: Save project
tools.description: Save the project (optionally Save As to a new .aep path). Save As never replaces an existing file unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Save As over an existing file at path (default false: refuse).

tools.name: ae_open_project
tools.title: Open project
tools.description: Open an .aep/.aet project file. Unsaved changes in the current project are discarded only if discardChanges is true.

tools.name: ae_list_comps
tools.title: List compositions
tools.description: List all compositions with id, size, duration, frame rate and layer count.

tools.name: ae_get_comp_info
tools.title: Get composition info
tools.description: Composition settings plus a summary of its layers (index, id, name, type, timing, parent, switches). Large comps are paged: use layerOffset/layerLimit (see totalLayers / nextLayerOffset in the result).

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

tools.name: ae_create_comp
tools.title: Create composition
tools.description: Create a new composition and (by default) open it in the viewer.

folder.description: Project item id (number) or exact name.

tools.name: ae_get_layer_info
tools.title: Get layer info
tools.description: Full info for one layer: switches, timing, parent, source, transform values, effects, masks count, markers, text, and every animated/expression property.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

tools.name: ae_add_layer
tools.title: Add layer
tools.description: Add a layer to a composition: solid, text, shape (empty, use ae_add_shape to draw), null, adjustment, camera, light, or an existing project item (footage/comp).

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

boxSize.description: Paragraph (box) text size [w,h]; omit for point text.

direction.description: Paragraph direction (AE 24+). Default: text without Hebrew/Arabic characters is set left to right whatever the user's AE type preference is.

item.description: For type 'item': project item to add.

duration.description: Layer duration in seconds (default comp duration).

moveToIndex.description: Move the new layer to this 1-based index (new layers are added on top).

tools.name: ae_get_selection
tools.title: Get selection
tools.description: What the user has selected: project items, and in the active comp the selected layers and selected properties (with paths).

tools.name: ae_get_properties
tools.title: Get properties
tools.description: Inspect the property tree of a layer (or a sub-group via path): names, match names, values, keyframe counts, expressions. Use this to discover property paths before setting values.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

path.description: Start at this group/property (default: the whole layer).

tools.name: ae_find_properties
tools.title: Find properties
tools.description: Search every layer of a comp (or one layer) for properties whose name or match name contains the query, e.g. "opacity", "blur", "Source Text", "ADBE Fill Color". Returns ready-to-use paths. Filter to animated or expression properties.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to match in the property name or match name. Omit to list all matches of the filters.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

tools.name: ae_set_property
tools.title: Set property value
tools.description: Set the value of any property (transform, effect parameter, shape attribute, text...). If `time` is given (or the property already has keyframes) a keyframe is set at that time. Examples: path "Transform/Opacity" value 50; "Transform/Position" [960,540]; "Transform/Scale" [50,50]; "Effects/Fill/Color" "#ff0000".

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

path.description: Property path from the layer, "/"-separated display names or match names, e.g. "Transform/Position", "Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness", "ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Opacity", "Contents/Rectangle 1/Fill 1/Color".

value.description: Value: number, array ([x,y] / [x,y,z] / color), string for text, or object for text style / shape path.

tools.name: ae_set_keyframes
tools.title: Set keyframes
tools.description: Create keyframes on a property in one call, with optional interpolation (linear/bezier/hold) and temporal easing. Place keys by time (seconds) or frame (whole frames). Example: path "Transform/Position", keyframes [{time:0,value:[0,540]},{frame:24,value:[960,540],easeIn:80}].

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

path.description: Property path from the layer, "/"-separated display names or match names, e.g. "Transform/Position", "Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness", "ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Opacity", "Contents/Rectangle 1/Fill 1/Color".

frame.description: Whole frame from the comp's start, instead of time.

value.description: Value: number, array ([x,y] / [x,y,z] / color), string for text, or object for text style / shape path.

easeIn.description: Temporal ease: influence % (e.g. 75 = strong easy-ease), {speed, influence}, or one {speed, influence} per dimension (2D/3D values; 1 for Position and other spatial properties).

easeOut.description: Temporal ease: influence % (e.g. 75 = strong easy-ease), {speed, influence}, or one {speed, influence} per dimension (2D/3D values; 1 for Position and other spatial properties).

easyEase.description: Apply easy ease (33%) to all new keyframes that don't specify easing.

tools.name: ae_set_expression
tools.title: Set expression
tools.description: Set (or clear with an empty string) an expression on a property. Returns any expression error AE reports.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

path.description: Property path from the layer, "/"-separated display names or match names, e.g. "Transform/Position", "Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness", "ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Opacity", "Contents/Rectangle 1/Fill 1/Color".

tools.name: ae_get_effect_params
tools.title: Inspect effect parameters
tools.description: List an effect's parameters (names, match names, value types, defaults, min/max) WITHOUT changing your layers, so you know the exact parameter names for ae_apply_effect / ae_set_effect_params. Pass comp+layer to inspect an effect already applied (current values).

effect.description: Match name (e.g. "ADBE Glo2") or display name ("Glow"); with comp+layer, also an index in the stack.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Inspect the effect on this layer instead of a fresh default instance.

tools.name: ae_apply_effect
tools.title: Apply effect
tools.description: Apply an effect to a layer by match name (preferred, e.g. "ADBE Gaussian Blur 2", "ADBE Fill", "ADBE Glo2", "ADBE Drop Shadow") or display name, optionally setting parameters. Returns the effect's parameters.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

params.description: Effect parameters by display name or match name, e.g. {"Blurriness": 20, "Repeat Edge Pixels": true} or {"Color": "#ff0000"}.

tools.name: ae_add_shape
tools.title: Add shape
tools.description: Draw a shape (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, or custom path) with fill and/or stroke, on a new shape layer or an existing one. Positions are relative to the layer (new layers are centered in the comp).

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layer.description: Existing shape layer; omit to create a new one.

fill.description: Fill color; omit for no fill (unless no stroke either: defaults to white).

tools.name: ae_add_to_render_queue
tools.title: Add to render queue
tools.description: Add a composition to the render queue with an output path and optional templates (see ae_list_render_queue for template names).

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

outputPath.description: Absolute output file path (extension should match the output module).

outputModuleTemplate.description: e.g. "High Quality", "H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps", "Lossless with Alpha".

tools.name: ae_undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undo the last action(s) in After Effects (Edit > Undo).

tools.name: ae_get_layer_bounds
tools.title: Layer bounds
tools.description: Exact on-screen bounding boxes of layers in composition pixels at a time, after all transforms, parenting, 3D and the active camera (via AE's own toComp()). Also reports whether each layer is visible at that time, fully/partly/not in frame, and inside action-safe (5% margin) and title-safe (10% margin). Use it to check alignment, spacing, overlaps and safe areas with numbers.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layers.description: Layers to measure (default: all layers, up to 300).

items.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

selectedOnly.description: Measure only the layers selected in After Effects.

frame.description: Whole frame number from the comp's start (frame 0 = time 0), instead of time.

includeExtents.description: Include stroke widths, effects and other extents (default false = content box).

tools.name: ae_get_comp_map
tools.title: Composition structure map
tools.description: Overview of how a composition is built: the tree of nested precomps (with how many times each is used), parenting chains, track mattes, and which layers/comps each expression references. Use it to understand an unfamiliar project before editing.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

depth.description: How deep to follow nested precomps (default 4).

tools.name: ae_get_keyframes
tools.title: Keyframe table
tools.description: Read keyframes as a table across many layers and properties in one call: for every key its whole frame number AND exact time in seconds, exact value, in/out interpolation, temporal ease per dimension (speed in the property's units per second, influence %) exactly as After Effects stores them, continuous/auto-Bezier, spatial tangents and roving (spatial properties), label. A key that is not on a whole frame is flagged with offFrame (fraction of a frame). curves: true adds, per segment between keys, the normalised curve (cubic-bezier x1,y1,x2,y2 per dimension; along the path for spatial properties). The output's properties[] can be edited and written back with ae_set_keyframe_table.

comp.description: Composition: item id (number) or exact name. Omit (or "active") for the active/open composition.

layers.description: Layers (default: every layer of the comp).

items.description: Layer: 1-based index (number) or exact layer name.

selectedOnly.description: Only the layers selected in After Effects.

paths.description: Properties or groups to read on each layer (default: every animated property). The returned paths resolve in any AE language.

items.description: Property path from the layer, "/"-separated display names or match names, e.g. "Transform/Position", "Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness", "ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Opacity", "Contents/Rectangle 1/Fill 1/Color".

startFrame.description: Only keys at or after this frame.

endFrame.description: Only keys at or before this frame.

curves.description: Add the normalised curve numbers of every segment.

tools.name: ae_render_background
tools.title: Render in background
tools.description: Render a composition (or a render queue item) with aerender in a separate process, so After Effects stays usable. It renders the project as saved on disk: pass save:true to save the open project first (required when it has unsaved changes). Returns a job id; check progress with ae_render_jobs and cancel there.

comp.description: Composition to render (id or name; default: the active comp).

rqIndex.description: Render this render queue item with its own settings instead of a comp.

output.description: Absolute output path (with comp). Extension should match the output module.

outputModuleTemplate.description: e.g. "High Quality", "H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps".

save.description: Save the open project first (needed if it has unsaved changes).

tools.name: ae_render_jobs
tools.title: Background render jobs
tools.description: Status and progress of background renders started with ae_render_background (this session), or cancel one.

tools.name: ae_batch
tools.title: Batch edits
tools.description: Run many steps in ONE call: each step is a tool with its arguments (any project/comp/layer/property/keyframe/effect/text/footage tool) or {tool: "ae_run_script", args: {code}}. All steps form a single undo step and return one change report. Atomic by default: if any step fails, everything is undone and you get the error of the failing step. Use it for repetitive or multi-part edits (e.g. style 30 layers, build a scene) to save round trips.

atomic.description: Undo everything if a step fails (default true). false = keep successful steps and continue.

name.description: Undo step name shown in After Effects (default "Surehand MCP Batch").

checkpoint.description: Save a project checkpoint before running (see ae_checkpoint).

verbose.description: Return each step's full result (default: short summaries).

tools.name: ae_checkpoint
tools.title: Project checkpoints
tools.description: Safety copies of the project: save (saves the open project, then keeps a timestamped copy), list the checkpoints of this project, or restore one (opens it as a NEW file next to the original; neither the original nor an earlier restore is ever overwritten). Use before large or risky changes.

label.description: Short label for a new checkpoint.

discardChanges.description: Restore even if the open project has unsaved changes (they are discarded).

tools.name: ae_list_scripts
tools.title: List scripts
tools.description: List the user's own After Effects scripts: AE's Scripts folder (and ScriptUI Panels) plus folders configured as "scriptFolders" in ~/.surehand/ae/config.json, with each script's description from its header comment. Run one with ae_run_script_file.

tools.name: ae_prove_identical
tools.title: Prove the render is unchanged
tools.description: Prove a structural change (un-precompose, bake expressions, reorder effects, simplify a rig) left the render unchanged, or show which frames and areas differ. capture: render reference frames (default: active comp, 5 frames over the work area), returns a proof id. compare: render them again and compare pixel by pixel (verdict, per-frame max difference, changed pixels, ΔE, area, difference image). run: capture, ae_batch steps, compare, in one call. For un-precompose, prove the parent comp. Only the sampled video frames are compared (alpha included; not audio, the comp background color or times between samples; 32 bpc values above 1.0 are clamped).

comps.description: capture/run: comps to prove (item id or exact name; default the active comp).

times.description: capture/run: exact times in seconds (snapped to frames) instead of evenly spaced frames.

frames.description: capture/run: number of frames spread over each comp's work area (default 5).

maxSize.description: capture/run: longest rendered side in pixels (default 1920; larger comps are scaled down).

id.description: compare: the proof id from capture (default the latest proof).

tolerance.description: compare/run: allowed difference per channel, 0-255 (default 0.5: less than one 8-bit step, so only 16/32 bpc rounding is allowed; 0 = bit-identical).

steps.description: run: the edits, as ae_batch steps.

atomic.description: run: as ae_batch (default true: a failed step undoes everything, and nothing is compared).

checkpoint.description: run: save a project checkpoint before the edits.

verbose.description: run: full result of each step.

tools.name: ae_get_scripting_guide
tools.title: ExtendScript guide
tools.description: Returns the After Effects ExtendScript cheat sheet (ES3 rules, helpers, common match names). Read before writing complex ae_run_script code.

tools.name: ae_tools
tools.title: More tools
tools.description: Discover every After Effects tool, including ones not loaded in this chat: list them by category (one line each), or describe chosen tools (full parameters). Then run any of them with ae_call. Categories: status & app, scripts, project, comps, layers, properties & keyframes, effects, shapes & masks, text, 3D, audio, footage, files & export, checks, see & measure, essential graphics, render.

describe.description: Tool names to get full parameter details for.

tools.name: ae_call
tools.title: Run any tool
tools.description: Run any After Effects tool by name with its arguments, e.g. tools listed by ae_tools that aren't loaded in this chat. Same validation, permissions, change report and activity log as calling the tool directly. Get the parameters with ae_tools {describe: [name]}.
